card.name: Digit 0 inside DOI and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside the number part of a DOI or ISBN in a reference citation, usually right after the 10. or 978 start.

modes.label: DOI prefix
modes.description: The 0 comes right after the 10. or 10.1 start of a DOI in a journal citation.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: The 0 sits within the digits of an ISBN after 978.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear link to this pattern, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the zero digit inside the long number codes of citations such as DOIs and ISBNs.
